title: Koala Listens to the Rain
tagline: The rain sings a gentle lullaby
description: On a rainy night, Baby Koala wakes up to the pitter patter on the leaves. Mama Koala teaches him to listen, and the rain becomes the softest lullaby of all.

characters.name: Baby Koala
characters.description: A little grey koala with round, fluffy ears.

characters.name: Mama Koala
characters.description: A warm mama koala who always holds her baby close.

cues.text: Tonight, the rain was falling on the eucalyptus tree.
Pitter patter, pitter patter, Baby Koala woke with a start.
“Mama, what’s that sound?” Baby Koala asked.
cues.speaker: tui

cues.text: Mama Koala held her baby close and warm.
“That’s the rain singing, let’s listen together,” Mama said.
cues.speaker: me

cues.text: Baby Koala closed his eyes and perked up his round ears.
Drip, drop, drip, drop, the raindrops danced on the leaves.
It sounded like someone playing a very soft drum.
Little one, tap the raindrop on the leaf!

interactions.hint: Tap the raindrop on the leaf

cues.text: Under the tree, Frog sang along, ribbit, ribbit.
The rain grew softer and softer, gentle as a lullaby.
Baby Koala snuggled into Mama, his breathing slow and calm.
“The rain is singing you to sleep,” Mama whispered.
cues.speaker: me

cues.text: Good night, little one. Let the rain sing you a lullaby.
